messages:
Maria K: Quick heads-up — I need to step out at 10:30 UTC, I'm primary for the morning but there's an active alert. Incident Bot already flagged a P1 (search latency spike in eu-west-1). I can't stay for the full tail; need someone to take primary and clarify escalation timing if latency stays high.

Josh P: I can take primary until noon UTC. Taking over now.

Samir C: I'll be secondary. @Josh P — follow the runbook 'search-high-latency' (https://redwood.internal/runbooks/search-high-latency). Key checks: cache priming, autoscale groups, recent deploys.

Incident Bot: ALERT: P1 — Search latency > 2.5x baseline in eu-west-1 for 7m. Pager routed to primary (Maria K).

Maria K: Thanks @Josh P. Handoff notes (quick):
- Likely cause: recent canary deploy + cache warmup + KV growth.
- Immediate triage: check cache eviction, error rates, and rolling deploys.
- Escalation rule for this class: if latency > 2x baseline for 10m OR error rate > 0.5% -> page infra-oncall, ops_lead at 10m if unresolved. If errors >1% page ops_lead immediately.
- Runbook pointer: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/search-high-latency (section 2 has quick mitigation).

Josh P: Copy. Kicking off triage. Samir — can you run the KV & deploy checks? Example commands:
```
# check redis memory and evictions
redis-cli -h cache-eu info memory | egrep "used_memory_human|maxmemory|evicted_keys"
# check last 30m deploys
git log --since="30 minutes" --pretty=oneline --abbrev-commit | head -n 5
```

Samir C: Running now. KV mem at ~78%, no evictions reported. Rolling restarts correlate with a failed canary ~8m ago on search-svc-v2. Canary rollback didn't complete.

Emily W: FYI customer-impact: Support has flagged three enterprise tenants (ACME, BeaconHealth, OmniRetail) seeing tail lat > 2s on search queries. I've opened ticket #3214 and set priority to P1 for support routing.

Josh P: If we see sustained >2x for 10m and support escalates, I will page infra-oncall and ops_lead per handoff guidance. I'll give a 10m timer before elevating unless errors tick up.

Asha (ops): Clarifying escalation matrix:
- Page infra-oncall (infra-oncall@pager) immediately for any P1 perf incident.
- If not resolved in 10 minutes or error rate > 0.5%, page ops_lead (ops-lead@pager).
- If not resolved in 30 minutes escalate to exec-oncall (exec@pager).
- If customer impact includes enterprise revenue loss notify CS-direct.
(keeping this to match our SLO-based escalation rules) :thumbsup:

Samir C: Found the failed canary job and manually triggered rollback of the bad deploy. Rollback in progress, pods terminating and re-creating.

Incident Bot: UPDATE: Rollback initiated for search-svc-v2. Latency dropping to ~1.3x baseline over last 3m. No additional pages sent.

Josh P: Good. I'll monitor for 30m and hold primary until noon, then update rotation. Samir, can you confirm post-rollback metrics and error rates at +5m and +15m?

Samir C: Will do. First check at +5 shows errors stable at 0.12% and p95 latency down to 420ms.

Maria K: Thanks everyone. I've added these notes to the handoff doc and linked the incident ticket and runbook. Going offline now — appreciate the takeover.

Josh P: Thanks @Maria K, enjoy your time. We'll close once metrics are stable and support confirms. :raised_hands:
